Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 33

“The sacrifice of knowledge is better than any material sacrifice, scorcher of foes. All action in its entirety culminates in knowledge, Partha.”

After treating the practices as equals, Krishna finally ranks them. Material offerings are real but instrumental; knowledge is where the whole enterprise was heading anyway.
